attributes.name: Oriented on meaningful outcomes
attributes.description: Each capability exists to deliver an outcome for the public, the environment or the department.

attributes.name: Stable over time
attributes.description: Capabilities change far more slowly than organisations, processes or systems.

attributes.name: Independent of organisation structure
attributes.description: A capability can be delivered by core Defra, an arm's length body or a partner.

attributes.name: Independent of technology
attributes.description: Capabilities say what we do, never which product does it.

attributes.name: Measurable
attributes.description: We can assess maturity, cost, risk and investment against each capability.

attributes.name: Expressed in active, plain language
attributes.description: Verb first, no jargon, understandable by anyone.

business_capabilities.name: Act as a custodian of the environment and ecosystems
business_capabilities.description: Understand, protect, restore and enhance the natural environment - land, water, air, seas, habitats and species - for current and future generations.
outcomes: Clean air and clean and plentiful water
level2: Protect and recover species and habitats
Manage land, water, air and marine resources
Manage flood and coastal erosion risk
Manage natural capital and biodiversity net gain

business_capabilities.name: Conduct research and analyse evidence
business_capabilities.description: Build and use the scientific, economic and social evidence base that underpins policy, regulation and operational decisions.

business_capabilities.name: Create policy and legislation
business_capabilities.description: Develop, consult on, implement and evaluate policy, legislation and regulation, including international and trade agreements.
outcomes: Policy informed by those it affects

business_capabilities.name: Engage with citizens and organisations
business_capabilities.description: Inform, advise, listen to and build relationships with the public, farmers, businesses, partners and other stakeholders.
outcomes: Users can find what they need and do what they need to do
Strong relationships with the sectors we work with
level2: Handle enquiries, complaints and information requests

business_capabilities.name: Issue licences and permits
business_capabilities.description: Decide whether and on what terms people and organisations can carry out regulated activities, and keep registers of what has been permitted.
outcomes: Regulated activity happens safely and lawfully

business_capabilities.name: Enforce compliance
business_capabilities.description: Check that people and organisations meet their obligations and take proportionate action when they do not.
outcomes: Harm prevented, and stopped quickly when it happens

business_capabilities.name: Administer funds and grants
business_capabilities.description: Design and run schemes that pay public money for public goods, from application to payment, verification and recovery.
outcomes: Public money delivers environmental and economic outcomes
Payments are accurate, on time and protected from fraud

business_capabilities.name: Respond to incidents and crises
business_capabilities.description: Prepare for, detect, respond to and recover from emergencies such as animal and plant disease outbreaks, floods, droughts and pollution.
outcomes: Reduced harm to people, animals, plants and the environment

business_capabilities.name: Operate and deploy assets
business_capabilities.description: Plan, build, operate, maintain and dispose of physical assets such as flood defences, laboratories, vessels, land and estate.
outcomes: Assets are available and perform when needed

business_capabilities.name: Set organisational direction
business_capabilities.description: Set strategy and priorities, allocate investment, manage performance and risk, and govern the department and its arm's length bodies.

business_capabilities.name: Provide shared services
business_capabilities.description: Provide the people, finance, commercial, digital, data and technology, estates, legal and information services the rest of Defra relies on.
outcomes: Staff have the tools and support to do their jobs
level2: Provide digital, data and technology services
